text:
anya: heads up — on the new 7B-long model (q8_longctx) I'm seeing token drift once we cross ~64k tokens. repro attached below. :frowning_face:
marc: can you paste the minimal repro here?
anya: short repro: run inference with a long concatenated prompt (~66k tokens) and compare FP16 vs q8 outputs. q8 diverges in the logits after the RoPE wrap boundary.
kevin: hmm, is this the classic rotary wraparound or something new caused by quantization?
anya: looks like an interplay. FP16 stable across the boundary. q8 shows micro-shifts in KV entries which accumulate. early suspicion: rounding in matmul -> different phase alignment for RoPE at high positions.
ravi: do you have a diff of the cached KV keys around the breakpoint?
anya: pasted below (trimmed):
```
# kv dump index 65528..65544 (hex)
FP16: 0x3f8ab4c2 0x3e9271a0 0x3f12b2ff ...
Q8:   0x3f8ab4c1 0x3e9271a2 0x3f12b300 ...
# small per-entry differences but pattern becomes non-linear past 65536 offset
```
marc: thanks. what's the exact command you used? can CI run it?
anya:
```
python -m rwd.eval \
  --model redwood-new-7b-q8_longctx \
  --input tests/fixtures/long_joined.txt \
  --save-kv ./out/kv_dump.bin \
  --max-toks 70000 \
  --stream-kv True
```
kevin: CI bot should be able to run float16 and q8 variants and then run rwd-tools kv-compare.
ci-bot: queued job #3412: redwood-new-7b {fp16,q8_longctx} kv-compare (longctx stress). ETA ~12m.
ravi: if CI reproduces, can we try two quick mitigations: (1) apply higher-precision RoPE multiplication in the kernel for positions > 60000, (2) test using symmetric quant calibration for KV buffers instead of per-channel.
anya: I'm on (2) now — swapping calibration reduces the drift magnitude by ~3x but doesn't eliminate divergence.
marc: try forcing a small exponent correction patch for RoPE rotations (multiply by 1.0001 at wrap region) as a diagnostic — if that reduces hallucination, it points at scaling aliasing.
kevin: also check the shard boundary code: when we compact KV shards for long contexts we might be rebase-indexing offsets; off-by-one there would amplify with quant noise.
anya: verified shard offsets are consistent with metadata. no off-by-one.
ravi: any quality regression in generation (not just logits)? examples?
anya: yes — when the model continues past 65k tokens it starts repeating the last sentence and then fabricates a short unrelated paragraph. FP16 continues the narrative fine.
kevin: please attach a short diff of generated text (fp16 vs q8).
anya: attached in the thread — but quick excerpt:
FP16: "She walked into the café and found..."
Q8:   "She walked into the café and found... She looked up. The river tasted like iron and she remembered a childhood..."
marc: weird hallucination. could be cache corruption or wrong RoPE phase reset.
ci-bot: job #3412 completed: kv-compare shows per-layer rms error spikes at layers 10 and 22 post-65536; quantization calibration reduced RMS by 3x but spikes remain.
ravi: next steps proposal:
- run end-to-end with FP32 compile for just the RoPE kernel at high positions
- add unit test for kv-dump equality across quant modes up to 70k tokens
- try int8 symmetric vs asymmetric calibration sweep
- repro on Dedicated pool (different cuBLAS/driver) to rule out hardware-specific fp rounding
anya: agree. I'll open a short PR with the test and the calibration sweep config. linking results once CI reruns. :thumbsup:
marc: thanks — can you tag me and kevin on the PR. want to prioritize before release candidate cut. :eyes:
